items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: I'll be up there with Emile and some of the City Councilmen and things.

ctx.x: But when you were working with one of the bands?

No. I happened to be out at Yankee Stadium, looking at the ballgame one day. He come through there, and some of the boys knew him. I said, 'Is that George Raft?' -- he had on a green suit and purple shoes and a brown hat. And he walked up there and he shook hands with us... I remember I was always meeting... Well, even now, Emile(?) and all that, they... When they have some of these big speakers up here at this Martin Luther King Center and things like that, and I'll be up there with Emile and some of the City…
He doesn't know anything about who Buster Smith is.
